faqs.q: Does HDFC Millennia cashback work on Swiggy orders under ₹150?
faqs.a: HDFC’s current MITC uses complete ₹100 transaction blocks. A qualifying direct Swiggy purchase below ₹100 earns no CashPoints under that rule. A purchase of ₹100–₹149 can earn on the first ₹100 if the merchant ID is eligible and there is cap remaining.

faqs.q: Is HDFC Millennia cashback real cashback or reward points?
faqs.a: You earn HDFC CashPoints. You can redeem them for statement credit at ₹1 per CashPoint, subject to a 500-point minimum, a 3,000-point calendar-month redemption ceiling and ₹50 plus tax per redemption. Other redemption routes have different values.

faqs.q: Can I get the HDFC Millennia fee waived?
faqs.a: HDFC lists ₹1,000 plus applicable tax for renewal. Its fee schedule says to spend over ₹1 lakh in the year before renewal for the waiver. Confirm qualifying spend and the renewal period on your account. The separate quarterly milestone is a different benefit.

faqs.q: Is HDFC Millennia better than Amazon Pay ICICI?
faqs.a: For eligible Amazon.in goods, Amazon Pay ICICI can earn 5% with Prime or 3% without it, as Amazon Pay balance. Millennia’s 5% tier also covers nine other listed merchants, but they draw from the same calendar-month cap. Compare both on your own basket after membership and redemption costs.

faqs.q: What happens after I hit the ₹1,000 monthly cap?
faqs.a: The named-merchant and other eligible purchase buckets each have a 1,000-CashPoint calendar-month cap. When you exhaust the 5% bucket, further purchases in that bucket do not switch to 1%. Purchases eligible for the separate 1% bucket can still earn until its own cap. Use the settlement date to track each bucket.

faqs.q: Where is Amex not accepted in India that I should know about?
faqs.a: Acceptance varies by merchant and payment channel. Check the stores and sites you use regularly before relying on any monthly bonus.

faqs.q: Do Amex MR points expire?
faqs.a: Check the current Membership Rewards terms for your account. Account closure and account standing can affect when you can redeem your balance.

faqs.q: Can I transfer Amex MR points to IndiGo or SpiceJet?
faqs.a: Check the current transfer list in your India Membership Rewards account. Direct transfers to either airline are unverified here. Booking a flight with points is a separate redemption route.

faqs.q: Is the Amex MRCC worth having alongside a better rewards card?
faqs.a: Compare the Amex bonuses you can earn on spending you already do, the redemptions you would use, and the renewal fee after any waiver. A second card can cover merchants that do not accept Amex.

faqs.q: Does Amex MRCC have any welcome bonus for new card holders?
faqs.a: Amex displays a 4,000-point welcome offer subject to its terms. The issuer currently reports a pause in accepting new applications in India.

faqs.q: How do EDGE Miles transfers work?
faqs.a: Use Travel EDGE to transfer eligible EDGE Miles to a participating partner account. Check the partner conversion rate, availability, annual group limits and ₹199 transfer fee before confirming the transfer.

faqs.q: Is Atlas better than HDFC Regalia for travel?
faqs.a: Atlas is designed around selected direct bookings, Travel EDGE and partner miles transfers. Regalia has a separate points programme. Compare the exact travel redemption, annual fee and lounge eligibility for your issued variant. The original Regalia is a legacy product rather than Regalia Gold.

faqs.q: Does Atlas have zero forex markup?
faqs.a: No. Axis lists a 3.5% foreign currency transaction fee. International transactions billed in INR can also fall under a separate 3.5% dynamic currency conversion charge under the issuer’s terms.
